title: S22: ResetSignalMonitor.isApplying is an unsynchronized bool touched from nonisolated Tasks

description: A real race, damage capped by a downstream guard. ControlInbox silently discards undecodable events forever, and AppliedEventStore grows unbounded. Severity: Medium. Wave/Plan: Wave 3, plan 3b reset-propagation-safety. Sweep: sync machinery. Fix: isApplying -> actor; undecodable events quarantined.
